name: sources
description: Read-only access to company systems for pages that present data: GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, Databricks, Postgres and Oracle. A gatherer subagent reads the session's connectors, and script collectors read with keys from the environment behind a SQL guard and read-only sessions; both write facts.json with the query behind every number and a digest for Claude to read. /sources:connect sets up a system.
